description: Optimization model for the operating cost reduction of DC Microgrid under real-time pricing is a model or code deposit deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Xiaoyan Qian. An optimization model with heuristic algorithmis implemented to optimize the virtual resistances of droopcontrol for the grid-connected converters of dispatchable units, such that the power flow can be regulated. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
